mapper.insert: insert into visitor (user_id, name, id_type, id_number, phone, status) values (#{userId}, #{name}, #{idType}, #{idNumber}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.select: select v.id, v.user_id, v.name, v.id_type, v.id_number, v.status, vi.fingerprint from visitor v join visitor_identity vi on vi.visitor_id = v.id where v.user_id = #{userId} and v.status = 'ACTIVE'
